name: fix_csharp_parallel_race
description: Fixes a non-atomic increment under Parallel.For with Interlocked
prompts: HitCounter.Count in HitCounter.cs increments a shared long from Parallel.For workers with `total++`, which is a read-modify-write race - at millions of iterations it reliably loses updates. Fix HitCounter.cs so Count always returns exactly workers * perWorker under parallel execution (Interlocked.Increment, or per-worker locals merged with Interlocked.Add - your choice). Keep the signature. Do not create or modify Program.cs.
